Question: How much of the mockup :root is wired into the legacy QSS in theme.py?

Question: Legacy danger colour: #A82424 fill vs mockup --danger #FF4D4D
Choice: Keep #A82424 as the legacy danger button fill; #FF4D4D only on the danger hover edge
Why: Byte-identical until screens opt in; K-1 LabelledAction danger must settle the fill and text colour (W1-1 conflict record)

Question: Radii and spacing in the legacy QSS
Choice: Radius and spacing tokens are defined in tokens.py but not wired into theme.py
Why: Legacy radii are 5, 7, 9 and 10 px, not the mockup 6, 8, 12 scale; wiring them would change the look before any screen opts in

Question: Token value format in tokens.py
Choice: Keys are CSS names with dashes as underscores; colours upper-case hex; px sizes as int; outer viewer tokens (page, ink, ink2, ink3, rule) included but unused by the app
Why: Matches theme.py hex style and lets string.Template write ${f_m}px; the test compares with the mockup :root case-insensitively

Question: LabelledAction danger: filled #A82424 (today's theme) or the mockup's outlined red?
Choice: Outlined: transparent, --dangerline edge, --dangertx text, --dangerdim on hover
Why: The fleet mockup's .btn.dng is outlined and the mockup's tokens win (decision 2026-10-05); the old filled class stays in theme.py for unconverted screens

Question: Where do the mockup's component-level literals (outside :root) and half-px font sizes go?
Choice: New KIT dict in ui/utils/tokens.py; 12.5px and 10.5px rounded up to 13 and 11
Why: TOKENS must equal the :root block (test_ui_tokens); kit.py stays hex-free; Qt px font sizes are ints

Question: Bar behaviors and COMPACT modes
Choice: SelectionBar enforces NoFocus and Open keeps label; ChipBar supports single_select, overflow and second-row; UnsavedBar default hidden when clean
Why: Matches IMPLEMENTATION.md 4.1/4.4 and fleet index.html specs

Question: DataGrid base class: QTableView with a new model, or QTableWidget (which is a QTableView)?
Choice: DataGrid subclasses QTableWidget; all drawing is in GridDelegate, which also works on any QTableView
Why: Every grid in the app (search, tracker, audit, sync) is a QTableWidget whose items carry the cell-format highlights (BackgroundRole/ForegroundRole); a drop-in subclass keeps the highlight engine and the attribute/item API tests reach untouched

Question: Migrate ToggleSwitch / FilterChip users now or leave them to R-2 / S-* packages?
Choice: Migrated now: sidebar toggle_admin -> kit.Switch (old ToggleSwitch class deleted); Manage Clients chips + More -> kit.Chip; Tracker Dump filter chips -> kit.Chip (literal ▾ left the label, the chip draws it; lock test text updated, behaviour unchanged)

Question: Kit Toast keeps a single-shot QTimer; does that break 'no timers'?
Choice: Kept
Why: It is the auto-hide of the alert it replaces (same show_alert duration API), started only on show; no polling or animation timers anywhere in the kit

Question: Screen scale row width
Choice: SettingRow width auto; combo, Apply and Restart now as its controls
Why: Combo plus two actions need more than the 230 px fixed column; wide 360 px is tighter at 1.25 scale

Question: Button variants and primary

Why: Settings General keeps Save changes as the only primary on that screen (rule 4)

Question: Where the scale row sits on Settings General
Choice: DisplayScaleControl added straight to the page layout inside a 12 px side wrapper; the old _setting_row wrapper dropped
Why: The control is now a full SettingRow, so _setting_row would show the title twice; 12 px (s_3) plus the row's 16 px makes the 28 px page rhythm

Question: Running-at line and hint
Choice: Running-at line is the row sub-label (set_sub after Apply); the hint moves to the dialog purpose line, shortened to fit one elided line
Why: SettingRow has one sub-label and DialogFrame purpose is a single elided line; the design puts the running-at line in the row

Question: Theme combo label
Choice: Label 'Dark', data stays 'light'
Why: Matches the mockup and the app's real look; the stored value is the golden-tested key so only the label changed.

Question: Clipboard-clear stepper step
Choice: Step 5 s, range 5-300, setValue is not snapped
Why: Stepper has no setRange/setSuffix; 5 s steps make 5-300 reachable; a saved odd value still loads unchanged.

Question: Dialog legacy QSS and compact trigger
Choice: Keep _apply_global_style for the 9 unconverted pages and child dialogs; compact is driven by dialog width minus nav (below 700 on, above 740 off)
Why: Arrangement-only package; other pages still need the legacy sheet. Dialog width is deterministic where the stacked pane width is stale before layout.

Question: Unsaved bar and two primary Save buttons
Choice: Bar shows on every page when dirty (reserved space); footer Save and bar Save both primary, as in the mockup
Why: Dirty tracking spans all pages, so the bar belongs to the shell. The mockup draws two Save buttons while dirty; both call the same save.

Question: Close with unsaved changes
Choice: Three-way prompt in reject(): Save changes / Discard changes / Keep editing
Why: reject() also serves Esc and the title-bar X, so one override guards all exits; Save closes only if the save left nothing dirty.

Question: Add a Banner on the S-2 pages?

Why: The fleet mockup puts no Banner on these pages; kept the layout to the mockup

Question: Office recovery Card title: mockup casing or existing test text?

Question: Are the SCC counts tiles interactive?

Question: How is a counts-load failure shown?
Choice: Eight dashes in the tiles plus a hidden-until-needed Banner reading Counts not available

Question: Are the password fields shown as plain text?

Question: Does the live preview show full resolved values?

Question: Visibility pages: Switch or Checkbox per column?

Question: MCL row actions: sm buttons, drag reorder, Edit button?
Choice: Regular-height LabelledActions (Edit, Move up, Move down, Delete column... set apart); per-row drawn Edit CellAction too; Alt+Up/Alt+Down shortcuts; no drag handle

Question: When does Save write the visibility flags?
Choice: A flag set is written when its visibility page was opened (as before) or when a Shows-on tick made it differ from the loaded value; values come from the shared model self.mcl_columns
Why: Keeps the golden settings and old write behaviour; satisfies 4.3 'Save writes the right rows and only those'
